_comments: Questing: single-phase azure-proxy validation. Emits METRIC: key=value lines for JSON summary.

image_catalog._comments: Custom Gen2 image for questing server amd64.

tests.name: phase1-azure-proxy-checks-and-shutdown
tests._comments: All checks in one phase, then shutdown.
commands: #ENFORCEPROXYAGENT#
# --- basic VM and azure-proxy-agent service checks ---
systemctl is-active azure-proxy-agent && echo METRIC:service_active=1 || echo METRIC:service_active=0
dpkg -s azure-proxy-agent >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo METRIC:service_installed=1 || echo METRIC:service_installed=0
systemctl show -p ActiveState azure-proxy-agent | grep -q '=active' && echo METRIC:service_running=1 || echo METRIC:service_running=0
systemctl show -p SubState azure-proxy-agent | grep -q '=running' && echo METRIC:service_substate_running=1 || echo METRIC:service_substate_running=0
echo METRIC:systemd_failed_units=$(systemctl --failed --no-legend | wc -l)
echo METRIC:ssh_session_ok=1
# --- Shutdown Inhibitor Metrics ---
echo METRIC:shutdown_blockers=$INHIB_BLOCK_SHUT
echo METRIC:shutdown_delayers=$INHIB_DELAY_SHUT
echo METRIC:shutdown_inhibitors=$((INHIB_BLOCK_SHUT + INHIB_DELAY_SHUT))
# --- Clean boot systemd must be 'running' ---
SYSTEM_STATE="$(systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"; [ "$SYSTEM_STATE" = "running" ] && echo METRIC:system_state_running=1 || echo METRIC:system_state_running=0
# --- cloud-init is completed ---
if cloud-init status --wait >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo METRIC:cloud_init_done=1; else echo METRIC:cloud_init_done=0; fi
systemctl is-active cloud-init.service >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo METRIC:cloud_init_active=1 || echo METRIC:cloud_init_active=0
systemctl is-failed cloud-init.service  >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo METRIC:cloud_init_failed=1 || echo METRIC:cloud_init_failed=0
# --- azure-proxy-agent service unit directives (systemd dependencies) ---
systemctl cat azure-proxy-agent | grep -q '^DefaultDependencies=no$' && echo METRIC:svc_declares_defaultdeps_no=1 || echo METRIC:svc_declares_defaultdeps_no=0
systemctl show azure-proxy-agent -p Before | grep -q 'network-pre.target' && echo METRIC:svc_declares_before_network_pre=1 || echo METRIC:svc_declares_before_network_pre=0
systemctl show azure-proxy-agent -p Before | grep -q 'shutdown.target' && echo METRIC:svc_declares_before_shutdown=1 || echo METRIC:svc_declares_before_shutdown=0
systemctl show azure-proxy-agent -p Conflicts | grep -q 'shutdown.target' && echo METRIC:svc_declares_conflicts_shutdown=1 || echo METRIC:svc_declares_conflicts_shutdown=0
# --- effective boot order: azure-proxy-agent must start before network-pre.target ---

AZURE_ENTER_RAW="$(systemctl show -p ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic --value azure-proxy-agent 2>/dev/null)"; NPRE_ENTER_RAW="$(systemctl show -p ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic --value network-pre.target 2>/dev/null)"; AZURE_ENTER="${AZURE_ENTER_RAW//[^0-9]/}"; [ -z "$AZURE_ENTER" ] && AZURE_ENTER=0; NPRE_ENTER="${NPRE_ENTER_RAW//[^0-9]/}"; [ -z "$NPRE_ENTER" ] && NPRE_ENTER=0; if [ "$AZURE_ENTER" -gt 0 ] && [ "$NPRE_ENTER" -gt 0 ] && [ "$AZURE_ENTER" -lt "$NPRE_ENTER" ]; then echo METRIC:svc_started_before_network_pre=1; else echo METRIC:svc_started_before_network_pre=0; fi
#SHUTDOWN#

policies._comments: Policy rules for single-phase questing validation.

global.name: ssh_reachable
global.message: VM must be reachable over SSH.

global.name: system_running
global.message: System must be in 'running' state (not degraded).

global.name: service_declares_shutdown_edges
global.message: azure-proxy-agent.service must declare Before=shutdown.target and Conflicts=shutdown.target.

global.name: service_started_before_network_pre
global.message: azure-proxy-agent must activate before network-pre.target (effective boot order).

global.name: shutdown_inhibitors_zero
global.message: No shutdown inhibitors left active before shutdown.
